Name: Haley's Lazy Morning
Author: llggw
Description:
婚后海莉有时会赖床。春、夏、秋季有 15% 的概率，冬季有 30% 的概率，她会在上午 9:00 之前赖在床上不肯起来。走过去跟她互动，她会用慵懒的语气跟你撒娇——当然，用的是她最可爱的害羞立绘。

9:00 之后一切恢复正常，她会像平时一样开始一天的行程。

功能
海莉婚后有概率赖床（春夏秋 15%，冬季 30%）
上午 9:00 前强制待在床上，不可移动
互动时显示专属慵懒对话（含冬季特殊台词）
使用海莉害羞立绘
9:00 后自动恢复正常日程
安装
确保已安装 SMAPI
将 HaleysLazyMorning 文件夹解压到 Stardew Valley/Mods 目录
启动游戏
兼容性
需要 SMAPI 4.0+
与修改海莉婚后日程的模组可能有冲突
不依赖 Content Patcher
Description
After marriage, Haley sometimes just can't get out of bed. She has a 15% chance of sleeping in during Spring, Summer, and Fall, and 30% during Winter. Until 9:00 AM, she'll stay in bed and respond to your interactions with sleepy, affectionate dialogue—accompanied by her adorable blush portrait.

After 9:00 AM, everything returns to normal and she resumes her daily schedule.

Features
Haley may sleep in after marriage (15% Spring/Summer/Fall, 30% Winter)
Locked in bed until 9:00 AM
Custom sleepy dialogue on interaction (including a winter-exclusive line)
Uses Haley's blush portrait ($4)
Resumes normal schedule after 9:00
Installation
Make sure SMAPI is installed
Extract the HaleysLazyMorning folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
Launch the game
Compatibility
Requires SMAPI 4.0+
May conflict with mods that alter Haley's marriage schedule
No Content Patcher dependency
